ak_candidates.description: Review retained source identity, measured fit and uncertain architectural candidates before promotion.

ak_promote.name: ak_promote
ak_promote.description: Promote one reviewed measured candidate using explicit construction height, thickness and centreline_offset_mm; no wall centreline is inferred from a visible face.

ak_export.description: Generate revision-bound IFC, architectural/shop drawings and schedules as a job. Geometry/schema evidence is separate from legal compliance and fabrication approval.

ak_check.name: ak_check
ak_check.description: Check model validity and explicit worldwide jurisdiction rule packs. Missing sources, facts or coverage remain not_verified; this does not certify a building.

ak_open.description: Prepare the optional archkiln GUI; launch=true starts an authenticated local interface using the same headless core. No browser window opens automatically.
